prior_descriptions.body:
Grades all 52 ATS and 52 totals from PR #42's pregame seal against independently reconciled ESPN and CFBD scores. ATS: 26–26; totals: 23–29. Adds deterministic ledgers, Weeks 5–8 diagnostic tables, validated scoring-sequence review and numerical proposals labeled RESEARCH ONLY. CLV remains INCOMPLETE; no Week 8 owner approval is invented.

Dependencies: repaired aggregate #41 → #42 (7f42da36f9aef4666bb715d49babde7ee374defa). Audit head: 922f1f8f8c66ef14674eb9aa20db144a45dada68. This draft targets main per repository workflow; incremental audit review begins after #42. Do not independently merge defective earlier ancestors without the #41 repairs.

Files: five new scripts (capture_week8_postgame_evidence.py, build_week8_postgame_audit.py, research_week8_diagnostics.py, week8_scoring_sequence_review.py, week8_numerical_research.py), tests/test_week8_postgame_audit.py, two new evidence directories, docs/WEEK8_POSTGAME_ENGINEERING.md and additive .gitattributes rules. No schema change. No production model, policy or historical artifact edit.

Behavior: writer fails closed on any existing output; verifier requires exact checksum coverage, consistent statuses and deterministic output bytes. 104 picks reconcile without omissions. All 47 protected files and 57 evidence files verify. One kickoff discrepancy is documented separately; frozen schedule bytes remain unchanged.

Executed commands:
```
python -m pytest tests/test_week8_postgame_audit.py -q
python -m scripts.build_week8_postgame_audit --verify
python -m scripts.week8_scoring_sequence_review --verify
python -m scripts.week8_numerical_research --verify
python -m scripts.seal_week8_board --verify
python -m scripts.verify_week7_audit_integrity

```
Audit adversarial suite: **19 passed in 29.90s**. Complete actual integration in dependent #45, commit 2631bfcf41c6c8c87f7d81246af58fdbc62389b2: **809 passed, 39 existing deprecation warnings, zero failures in 193.74s**. This contains the exact audit source/evidence from this head. All read-only gates pass. Full logs and exact commands: [integration engineering report](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/e3a9a10ed63c0aa003d16e88208331d1ff81e170/docs/WEEK9_EXECUTION_ENGINEERING.md).

Source database SHA256 remains 09d0bcda684356001bacf8bc9e42939add56b053f405564d9be924e39c0cf842. All 52 scoring sequences validate; zero selected-side backdoor covers meet the existing final-five-minutes definition. Original conservative ledger classifications remain preserved, with the supplement separate.

Limitations and risks: no timestamp-qualified historical closes; no Week 8 approved owner five; W5–6 rank order retrospective; small samples and recurring teams limit causal claims. Units are hypothetical risk-one-at-minus-110, not wager profits. One trailing whitespace diff warning in already hashed source is retained and explained. No unexplained test failures. GitHub has no check/status/workflow runs at the recorded audit head; independent review remains outstanding.

Rollback: leave draft unmerged or revert only additive audit commits while preserving custody evidence. No migration or source database regeneration. No unrelated files, original repository or NFL work changed. No model promotion or PR merge performed.

October 28 evening integration revalidation: #44 head remains 922f1f8f8c66ef14674eb9aa20db144a45dada68. Actual dependent #45 final head db007694d3ee87d3a2b85feacd1fd9b7a2d10fb0 contains this exact ancestor and preserves all 66 Week 8 audit/research files byte-for-byte. Complete suite rerun on that final integration commit: **809 passed, 39 existing deprecation warnings, zero failures, 240.94 seconds**. Eight read-only gates, including Week 7 custody, Week 8 seal/audit/scoring/research and Week 9 seal/context/owner review, all pass at that same commit. [Verification evidence](https://github.com/JCRABURN/cfb-betting-system-v3/blob/db007694d3ee87d3a2b85feacd1fd9b7a2d10fb0/outputs/2026-week9-verification/20261028-evening/ENGINEERING.md). #44 and #45 each have a COMMENTED owner review, not approval. No GitHub checks/statuses or Actions runs are registered at the recorded heads. Keep draft pending independent review and CI verification; no merge declared. Original selections, lines, forecasts, model confidence, timestamps, source custody, mixed research Top 5 and v2.8 remain unchanged. Owner approval is **PENDING**.

The latest separate human Top 5 is **Northwestern +3.5 (2/5), Navy +30.5 (2/5), Southern Miss–ULM Under 56.5 (2/5), SMU–Syracuse Under 58.5 (1/5), Troy +20.5 (1/5)**. FAU–North Texas Under 77.5 moves to alternative rank 6. All ten alternatives and prior revisions are retained. Human confidence is ordinal and uncalibrated; no numerical injury/weather adjustment, calibration change or market-diversification quota was applied.

**Test-run reconciliation and exact identities**

- Earlier run B: **240.94s**, 809 passed / 39 warnings. Its previously temporary log and exact-head gate record are now archived byte-for-byte. Attribution to db007694 relies on the contemporaneous completion wrapper and separate metadata; the pytest text itself contains no SHA. File mtime and later archival hashes are not misrepresented as original execution proof.
- Fresh reconciliation run C: **809 passed / 39 warnings / 193.64s**, with db007694 recorded before and after execution, empty tracked diffs, exact command/cwd, start/end UTC, exit 0 and output hash. Started Oct 28 23:09:39 UTC; completed 23:12:54 UTC.
- The full-suite result applies to **db007694**, not the later evidence-delivery commit. No full-suite run is claimed on 6e1948dd9b675a3f1226350ce5b40a6556e09f7a. Week 9 seal and current owner-review gates were rerun successfully after the evidence commit.

**Thursday decision evidence**
Troy’s official preview confirms Pettaway’s absence but also recurring Crowder injury. Last game Troy passed for 47 yards on 9/18. JMU’s 50.3 home points includes 87 against FCS Wagner; FBS-only home average is 38.0 (n=3), against Troy’s 11.0 road average (n=3). These are descriptive, opponent-dependent splits, not new forecasts. No evidence establishes that Pettaway absence outweighs Troy’s limitations. Troy stays a low-conviction fifth choice pending functional QB, OL and defense confirmation.

FAU/UNT’s 17.71-point gap is not a reliability estimate. Five archived audited games involving either team all exceeded forecast: bias/MAE +28.97, RMSE 32.00; all four Under picks lost. This is a small retrospective diagnostic, not a new calibration rule. Their latest games had 27/23 drive records and 139/129 scrimmage plays; explosive efficiency, return touchdowns and defensive scoring materially challenge the Under. Official notes report strong UNT OL continuity and low sacks allowed. Current depth charts are retained, but are not game-day medical clearance. Thursday wind is approximately 5 mph at UNT with 19–22% rain probability, not a strong Under signal.
